description: Perth Metro Lidar Capture Dates (LGATE-360) is a dataset listed in Western Australian Government data catalogue (catalogue.data.wa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Landgate. This dataset comprises of a 1km x 1km capture date index of the Perth Metro LiDAR acquisition only. LiDAR data or derivative datasets cannot be accessed or downloaded from this site This is currently only available upon completion of the Location Information Transactional Form (see ACCESS & USE INFORMATION below). Coverage: Western Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Landgate. Its tags are LiDAR capture index, Perth LiDAR capture index, capture dates, capture index, metro capture index. It offers 10 resource(s) in .zip shapefile, file geodatabase, mapinfo mid/mif, api arcgis server map service, fgdb, geojson, geopackage. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Custom (Other). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-au-wa-portal.
